t.E407.agn: In 2018 EFSA set an acceptable daily intake (ADI) of 75 mg/kg body weight on a temporary basis because of uncertainties in the chemistry, intake and toxicology data, and asked for the data to be completed within five years. Degraded carrageenan (poligeenan) is not permitted in food.
t.E407.body: It is not absorbed intact in the gut.
t.E407.eff.0.t: The daily limit was set on a temporary basis because of uncertainties in the chemistry, intake and toxicology data; the evaluation has not been completed
t.E407.eval: Obtained from red seaweed. In its 2018 re-evaluation EFSA considered the existing group ADI (75 mg/kg body weight per day) temporary because of data gaps, and reported that estimated intake in some population groups may exceed this value by up to 10 times.
t.E407.prod: Obtained from red seaweeds by extraction with water or dilute alkali.
t.E407.summary: A thickener obtained from red seaweeds. Used in dairy products, desserts, ice cream and processed meats.
